STATES: u0, u1, u2

FINAL_STATES: u2

(u0, switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, else) -> u0
(u1, at_exit) -> u2
(u1, else) -> u1

feedback: Semantic fidelity holds: the RM encodes the ordered task (flip the switch, then reach the exit). u0 waits for the switch_toggled event; at_exit occurring in u0 falls into the else self-loop, so exiting before the flip pays nothing, which matches 'reaching the exit is allowed only once the switch has been flipped'. Once in u1, repeated toggles and all other propositions (siren_ringing, holding_box, box_fell) are absorbed by the else self-loop, correctly treating a single flip as sufficient, since this task imposes no siren-silence or carry requirement. Persistent/event distinctions are respected: switch_toggled is a one-shot event used as a transition trigger, and at_exit (a last-step-only condition) gates entry to the accepting state; because switch_toggled and at_exit never co-occur, giving switch_toggled precedence over else in u0 is safe. Ordered transition coverage is complete: every state has exactly one else self-loop, so no proposition or event combination is uncovered, including the impossible-but-harmless at_exit in u0 and switch_toggled in u1/u2. Reachability and compactness are fine: u2 is reachable via u0->u1->u2, and three states is minimal for a two-milestone ordered task. The FINAL_STATES header is present and nonempty, its sole member u2 is declared in STATES and is accepting for this task. Reward safety holds: 0.1 at the toggle milestone and 1.0 at completion give dense, milestone-shaped progress, the total is bounded at 1.1, there are no negative or unbounded rewards, and implicit zero rewards on the self-loops are standard. No regression edges are required: once flipped, permission persists for the rest of the episode, and a possible siren restart does not revoke the flip under this task (the siren may restart after being silenced, but the task never demands silence). Format matches the paper's REWARD_MACHINE schema: STATES, INITIAL_STATE, FINAL_STATES, TRANSITION_FUNCTION with per-state else loops, and REWARD_FUNCTION entries consistent with the declared transitions ((u0, switch_toggled, u1) and (u1, at_exit, u2)).
